titulo: The universe heard you the first time
caption:
The universe heard you the first time. Stop repeating it. Start receiving it.

Save this for the next time you ask twice. Comment "heard" if you needed it.

Link in bio.
by NMR
#affirmations #universe #manifesting #naos
alt: A vertical film with soft drone music and no voice. Cella, a small figure made of white dots with two dark eyes and no hands, assembles itself out of dust and stands on a horizon of dots under a field of stars. One line of text appears at a time and its key word lights up in moon yellow: The universe heard you the first time. So stop repeating it. Start receiving it.
